sources.role: native platform builds, controls, BIOS/save filenames and persistent save-state slots

paths.path: Native SkyEmu application preferences; the upstream README does not specify a stable Linux config filename/path
paths.naming: Runtime/UI options are configured through the native UI or command line; no documented portable text config grammar is available in the cited source
Default keyboard syntax is WASD=d-pad, J=A, K=B, apostrophe=Select, Enter=Start, U=L, I=R; custom bindings are configured in the UI and no text binding-file grammar is published
evidence: docs:SkyEmu README Default Controls and controller support

paths.path: BIOS files beside the ROM on native builds
paths.naming: GBA BIOS filename is gba_bios.bin; GB boot aliases include dmg0_rom.bin, dmg_rom.bin and gb_bios.bin. SkyEmu also bundles open replacement BIOS/stubs; no canonical checksum is published by the cited upstream docs
evidence: docs:SkyEmu README Loading save files and BIOSs

paths.path: Same directory as the ROM on native builds
paths.naming: ROM basename with extension replaced by .sav (for example MyRomFile.gba -> MyRomFile.sav)
evidence: docs:SkyEmu README Loading save files and BIOSs

paths.path: Native persistent save-state storage managed by SkyEmu's four save-state slots
paths.naming: Four persistent slots with screenshot previews; the cited upstream README does not publish a native filename/path convention
